title: Bounded live adapter transport and deterministic event harness

privacy.projection: bindings, capability names, limits, states, dispositions, and digests only

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline

limitations: The model validates synthetic observations and never launches a process, provider, network, LLM, or tool.
Capability admission is not provider authorization; credential, network, human approval, and Coordinator lease validity remain external gates.
A completed offline trace is not live execution, hosted CI, remote consumption, AWQ acceptance, AWG decision, UI approval, or durable-state completion.
follow_up: AWQ must independently qualify evidence before any live integration.
AWG must decide material adapter alternatives; UI decisions require a private revision-bound session.
A later integration AR must provide Coordinator-approved lease and host enforcement evidence.
